title: Friends from Vegas and meeting Linda there
summary: He still sees Vegas colleagues like Ralph Enriquez and says he would do it again.

blocks.x: And you know what? And -- and -- and everybody in Vegas, like, we have friends there now, you know, like, Ralph Enriquez [phonetic sp.] who was the bass player with Liberace. He works at a record store there now and he sends us albums that we don't have or something, you know. Jerry Mullidor, talked to him and, oh, man, what's his name? Oh, the trumpet player, man, real good trumpet player. I mean, played his butt off, too, there in Vegas. I'll think of the name. But -- but all these guys, man, they're playing, you know. When I go down now, I try to see them.
I try to see them. And Linda met there, [indiscernible], so. I -- I'd do it again if I had
